svg.title: paddock: grouping
svg.desc: Recorded from paddock 0.1.0 in a scratch tmux server; staged sessions. Shows the agents grouped by status, session and folder. Steps: 1. Grouped by status: who needs you comes first. 2. ctrl-g groups by session. 3. Again: by folder, so one project stays together. 4. Once more: no headers, one list.
